description:
Outcome: Coordinator receives one daily email listing new problem reports, from owner decision
Scope: Authenticated scheduled job; garden-local daily schedule; durable digest records/cutoff, send tracking, retry/deduplication; sanitized content and delivery failure visibility. Excludes: Per-report emails and SMS
Acceptance: One scheduled digest per nonempty day; include reports created since last successful delivery cutoff even if already resolved; empty days send none; concurrent/retried jobs do not make separate digest records; failures retain pending data; delayed runs cover backlog; email links require sign-in
Behaviour: Coordinator can see outage/retry status; avoid secret/contact leakage; document duplicate risk after uncertain external send and use provider idempotency where available
Verification: Fake clock/provider tests for empty day, daylight-saving boundary, outage/retry, overlapping jobs, cutoff edge and resolved-new reports; real staging-email check. Prerequisites: T-001, T-011, T-012. Assumptions: Coordinator configures send time; provider credentials available for staging; no exactly-once external delivery claim
title: Reliable daily report email
